sources.title: GitHub - microsoft/DeBERTa: The implementation of DeBERTa
sources.snippet: 12/8/2021 DeBERTa-V3-XSmall is added. With only 22M backbone parameters which is only 1/4 of RoBERTa-Base and XLNet-Base, DeBERTa-V3-XSmall significantly outperforms the later on MNLI and SQuAD v2.0 tasks (i.e. 1.2% on MNLI-m, 1.5% EM score on SQuAD v2.0). This further demonstrates the efficiency of DeBERTaV3 models.

sources.title: deberta-v3-base: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview deberta-v3-base is a 12-layer transformer model with 86M backbone parameters and 128K token vocabulary (98M embedding parameters) developed by microsoft. This model improves upon previous DeBERTa versions through ELECTRA-style pre-training with gradient-disentangled embedding sharing, trained on 160GB of text data.
